newsitem.title: FINLAND: OKO UPS FINNISH 1997 GDP GROWTH FORECAST TO 4 PCT.
newsitem.headline: OKO UPS FINNISH 1997 GDP GROWTH FORECAST TO 4 PCT.

text.p: OKOBANK on Monday revised its forecast growth in
Finnish gross domestic product (GDP) next year to 4.0 percent
Its 1996 GDP growth forecast was unchanged at 2.5 percent.
OKOBANK said in a report that the cyclical outlook had
"Next year, economic recovery in the industrialised
countries will speed Finnish export growth. The domestic market
on the other hand will be supported by the eased income taxes,"
OKOBANK raised its forecast consumer price inflation next
year to two percent from one percent while it left its inflation
forecast for this year unchanged at one percent.
It raised its forecast for the current account surplus to 22
billion markka in 1996 and to 25 billion in 1997. Its previous
forecast was for 12 billion markka surpluses each year.
